about: The development set (R-453): run after every change to the reading (`moments.py all <file> --dev`, then `tools/golden/review.py score <file>`); every match is run only at a checkpoint (a new review set, a gate, a benchmark rebuild). Holds the matches of the review key, the golden moments, the line-up games, and the games of each whole-game review. Whole-game set w1 (R-454), picked 2026-11-13 from October and November games of the top eight guilds that no earlier test had used and that hold no Shadow of Haste run: four games, two and two (R-455): part 1 (TFS v 옷옷옷옷, Men v Apes) is marked first and fixed against; hdm v hook was marked on 2026-11-14 as the first measure of the rebuilt reading and is built from since (R-467); Men v Crew is the hidden game and 옷옷옷옷 v RACK the spare: neither is marked, looked at or fixed against. Set w2 is round 3 (R-473), picked 2026-11-14 from unused games since 22 October on halls not yet marked or guilds not yet seen: hook v hold (Nomad's Isle), cope v Team (Isle of Jade), chic v 戦戦戦戦 (Corrupted Isle); each is scored from his marks before anything is fixed against it. chic v 戦戦戦戦 was set aside unmarked on 2026-11-14 (a henchman game) and RJT v RACK on Nomad's Isle (eea5ba87) put in its place as part 2 of set w2 (a game with splits and flags on the hall where the splits read worst). hdm v 옷옷옷옷 (7209c1a1) left the set on 2026-11-14: a henchman game (R-477). Set w3 is round 4, picked 2026-11-15 after the rebuild from RJT v RACK (who is on a split; whose flag decision): HC v Team on Imperial Isle (9b5cdf62, 5 November), the unused game of two top ten guilds since 22 October in which the engine reads the most varied calls (flags, splits, numbers, pushes on the flagger); scored from his marks before anything is fixed against it. From 2026-11-15 (R-491, R-492, R-497) the games are graded his new way and start afresh as set f1: HC v Team is part 1; Men v Crew and 옷옷옷옷 v RACK are no longer kept back and wait as parts 2 and 3, each exported only when the game before it is marked and its Classic faults are fixed. Set f1 games 4 and 5, picked 2026-11-16 at his word ("prepare the next 2 games"): Men v RACK on Nomad's Isle and Men v hold on Isle of Meditation, both of 2026-11-01: the only unused games since 1 October between top-fourteen guilds, one of them top eight, on a hall other than the three already graded, with no Shadow of Haste bar and no henchman. Set f1 games 6 and 7, picked 2026-11-17 at his word ("proceed with the next two games"), from the unused games since 1 October between top-fourteen guilds, one of them top eight, with no Shadow of Haste bar and no henchman, eight minutes or longer: hdm v HC on Imperial Isle (bbef1904, 2 November), the one in which the engine reads the most varied calls (flags, splits, numbers, six pushes on a flagger: the pushes are held for a second game, R-495), and hold v Men on Uncharted Isle (b870f84e, 31 October), a hall not yet graded his new way. Left for later: HC v hdm on Isle of Jade (af831111), for the numbers through the portal. Game 6, hdm v HC (bbef1904), was taken out on 2026-11-18 unmarked, at his word: its replay on gvg.report is not adequate to review; it is in no set and is not to be picked again. Set f1 games 8 and 9, picked 2026-11-18 at his word from the same pool: HC v hdm on Isle of Jade (af831111, 25 October), for the numbers through the portal and the pushes on a flagger that are held for a second game (R-495), and RACK v hdm on Isle of Meditation (d06ef3c7, 17 October), a short game of splits and a held base. Set f1 games 10 to 12, picked 2026-11-18 at his word (split games, and games for what is held for a second game, R-495): hold v RACK on Imperial Isle (d492aa6c, 1 November), a long game of splits, full collapses and the Lord; HC v cope on Nomad's Isle (3d0f3fc5, 3 November), a short game of splits with a collapse and a push on a flagger; and 옷옷옷옷 v hdm on Isle of Jade (53175808, 2 October), for the numbers through the portal and a base res with attackers at the footmen. Set f1 games 13 and 14, picked 2026-11-18 at his word (R-532: one game each on the two most played halls he has not graded his new way), from the unused games between top-fourteen guilds, one of them top eight, with no Shadow of Haste run and no henchman, eight minutes or longer: Men v NwAy on Corrupted Isle (c19f13e3, 19 September), the most varied of them (splits, a held base, base reses, boosts), and Dz v Team on Druid's Isle (15a20f7a, 9 September), the only such game on that hall. Both halls were played only in September among the counted games of such guilds (the November games on Corrupted Isle are used, short or uneven). Game 12 stays graded as far as 9:40 (R-532). Game 13, Men v NwAy (c19f13e3), was taken out on 2026-11-18 unmarked, at his word (R-537): he marked game 14 and does not think game 13 is needed at this point; it is in no set, nothing was built against it, and Corrupted Isle is still not graded his new way. Set f1 game 15, picked 2026-11-20 at his word (one fresh split-heavy game to grade after the split readings were fixed, before he says whether splits are ready, R-559): Men v NwAy on Corrupted Isle (c19f13e3, 19 September, 15:50), the game taken out unmarked as game 13 (R-537: not needed at that point; nothing was built against it). Of the unused games between top-fourteen guilds, one of them top eight, with no henchman, eight minutes or longer, it is the only one with no Shadow of Haste run in which the engine reads more than four split situations (sixteen: joins, leaves, two full collapses), and it is on a hall not yet graded his new way; the others with many splits (RACK v hdm and cope v hdm on Uncharted Isle, 16 and 17 October) hold Shadow of Haste runs. The five games of set p3 that carry a check (Apes v cope, push v True, Men v hook, hold v hook, Book v Crew) were added on 2026-11-21. Two more games of set p3 were added on 2026-11-22, when R-581 was built and their rows got a check (옷옷옷옷 v cope, Crew v Team).
